text:
Marta Chen: Quick sync — kicking off a small terminology migration across docs + SDK snippets. Goal: canonical glossary names, migration guide, and nonbreaking SDK deprecation plan. Who can pick up tasks? :wave:
Jake Patel: I can own SDK snippets (Node/TS). Plan: search-replace in examples, produce codemod, open PR. ETA today afternoon.
Eli Gomez: I'll lead the glossary rename and prepare the canonical mapping. Need alignment on exact tokens and short rationale for each.
Marta Chen: Initial candidates (need discussion):
```
model_version -> model_ref
model_alias -> model_tag
dedicated_capacity -> dedicated
private_deploy -> private_deployment
paramCase vs snake_case: prefer snake_case for Python examples, camelCase for JS
```
Samira V: I'll run a link-check and build a redirect map for anchor renames. Anchors are fragile; I'll include a redirect file in a redirects PR.
Jake Patel: Clarifying Q: are we changing public SDK method names or only examples/param names? Breaking API renames require wrappers/aliases.
Eli Gomez: Proposal: update docs/examples/CLI params immediately. SDK public APIs: add alias wrappers that emit deprecation warnings for two releases, then remove. Include migration snippet showing old and new usage.
Marta Chen: Agreed. Migration guide should include: 1) glossary canonical list, 2) quick snippet edits, 3) SDK alias plan and timeline, 4) redirects & anchor fixes, 5) rollout checklist.
Noah (docs-bot): FYI — link-checker found 18 broken anchors in /docs/reference related to old token names. Will attach the list to the redirect PR.
Samira V: Thanks @Noah. I'll triage the 404s and post candidate redirects. Please review redirects before merge; anchor collisions are possible.
Jake Patel: SDK snippet sweep plan:
- run `rg "model_version|model_alias|dedicated_capacity|private_deploy" -n`
- replace tokens in examples only, not in production SDK code
- include small codemod and tests updated
I'll open a draft PR and flag CI failures.
Eli Gomez: For the glossary PR I'll create glossary.md with old->new mapping, short rationale for each token, and a cross-link to model lifecycle docs. We'll pin that in the style guide.
Marta Chen: Owners & branches:
- glossary: @Eli (branch docs/glossary/rename-2026)
- SDK snippets: @Jake (branch sdk/snippets/terminology-sweep)
- redirects & anchors: @Samira (branch docs/redirects/termino-fix)
- migration guide + rollout: I'll draft (branch docs/migration/terminology-2026) and request reviews.
Samira V: Ack. I'll post the redirect candidate list in the PR and tag eng-sre if infra-level redirects are needed.
Jake Patel: Note: some CI snippet tests assert exact strings. I will loosen matchers where appropriate and mark changes in the PR.
Eli Gomez: I'll add a short semantic note (e.g., why model_ref vs model_tag) to avoid future drift.
Marta Chen: Timeline: low-risk docs merged within 7 days, SDK aliasing staged across 2 releases. If no objections I'll post migration doc draft by EOD.
Jake Patel: I'll open draft PR now and add the codemod script as an optional helper.
Samira V: I'll run the link-checker and surface any anchor collisions.
Noah (docs-bot): Created checklist: glossary PR -> link-check -> redirects PR -> SDK snippet sweep -> migration doc. Will post CI reminders on each step.
Marta Chen: Thanks everyone, will follow up with the migration guide draft and assign reviewers. :slightly_smiling_face:
Jake Patel: Starting now.
Eli Gomez: Drafting glossary today.
Samira V: On it — will report collisions if found.
(No further replies)
